components.title: Dedupe orders
components.what: Remove exact duplicate order rows (same order_id and all fields) so each counts once

components.title: Filter valid statuses

components.title: Compute per-customer revenue
components.what: Sum units x unit_price for each customer across remaining orders

components.title: Identify top customer
components.what: Compare totals to find the customer name with highest revenue
